container.name: documents
container.query: SELECT c.id, c.displayName, c.documentFileName, c.description, c.type, c.typeId, c.milestoneId, c.projectPhaseId, c.documentAuthorTypeId, c.milestone, c.projectPhase, c.documentAuthorType, c.legislation, c.datePosted, c.projectId, c.read, c.isPublished, c.documentSource, c.isFeatured, c.documentFileName AS fileNameTokens, c.displayNameSort, c.sortOrder, c.fileSize, (((NOT IS_DEFINED(c.vis.displayName) OR (IS_INTEGER(c.vis.displayName) AND c.vis.displayName >= 4)) AND (NOT IS_DEFINED(c.vis.documentFileName) OR (IS_INTEGER(c.vis.documentFileName) AND c.vis.documentFileName >= 4)) AND (NOT IS_DEFINED(c.vis.description) OR (IS_INTEGER(c.vis.description) AND c.vis.description >= 4))) ? 4 : (((NOT IS_DEFINED(c.vis.displayName) OR (IS_INTEGER(c.vis.displayName) AND c.vis.displayName >= 3)) AND (NOT IS_DEFINED(c.vis.documentFileName) OR (IS_INTEGER(c.vis.documentFileName) AND c.vis.documentFileName >= 3)) AND (NOT IS_DEFINED(c.vis.description) OR (IS_INTEGER(c.vis.description) AND c.vis.description >= 3))) ? 3 : (((NOT IS_DEFINED(c.vis.displayName) OR (IS_INTEGER(c.vis.displayName) AND c.vis.displayName >= 2)) AND (NOT IS_DEFINED(c.vis.documentFileName) OR (IS_INTEGER(c.vis.documentFileName) AND c.vis.documentFileName >= 2)) AND (NOT IS_DEFINED(c.vis.description) OR (IS_INTEGER(c.vis.description) AND c.vis.description >= 2))) ? 2 : (((NOT IS_DEFINED(c.vis.displayName) OR (IS_INTEGER(c.vis.displayName) AND c.vis.displayName >= 1)) AND (NOT IS_DEFINED(c.vis.documentFileName) OR (IS_INTEGER(c.vis.documentFileName) AND c.vis.documentFileName >= 1)) AND (NOT IS_DEFINED(c.vis.description) OR (IS_INTEGER(c.vis.description) AND c.vis.description >= 1))) ? 1 : (((NOT IS_DEFINED(c.vis.displayName) OR (IS_INTEGER(c.vis.displayName) AND c.vis.displayName >= 0)) AND (NOT IS_DEFINED(c.vis.documentFileName) OR (IS_INTEGER(c.vis.documentFileName) AND c.vis.documentFileName >= 0)) AND (NOT IS_DEFINED(c.vis.description) OR (IS_INTEGER(c.vis.description) AND c.vis.description >= 0))) ? 0 : -1))))) AS searchVis, c._ts FROM c WHERE c._ts >= @HighWaterMark AND (NOT IS_STRING(c.scanStatus) OR c.scanStatus = 'clean') ORDER BY c._ts
